text:
Alex W: Quick question  for the marketplace/partner demo, can we include a prebuilt Datadog dashboard and a tiny OTEL example so SIs can onboard fast?
Priya S: yes. partner-facing kit should have 1) dashboard JSON, 2) short install snippet, 3) a troubleshooting bullet list.
Sam (eng): i'll add the OTEL snippet. runtime flag to enable enrichment: REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true. sample tag mapping: model_id -> dd.tag `model`, model_version -> `model_version`.
Jens: callout: limit enriched tag cardinality (avoid prompt_id in dashboards unless sampled). add sampling guidance.
Marcos: i'll produce the dashboard JSON with widgets: latency heatmap, token cost per model tag, error traces view. aiming EOD tomorrow.
Sam (eng): minimal OTEL exporter for demo:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers: { DD_API_KEY: "<redacted>" }
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Datadog-bot: dashboard-validate: widgets OK, tag-usage OK 
Alex W: perfect. timeline: drafts by tomorrow EOD, dry-run on Wed. tagging @Priya S and @Marcos to follow up. :thumbsup:
